scope: Transfer module: Point To Point (incl. Add Return, swap) and By Hour - form, validation, location picker, Trip Summary, vehicle list/filters/pricing, Vehicle Details & Transfer fare breakup, Confirm, Inquiry, Inquiry Details, payment attempt, Cancel Trip; baseline TC_HOME_033-037, TC_VDET_008 + gap cases
executedBy: Claude Code (App Live via Claude in Chrome)

credentials.method: Entered manually on device by the user; values from .env - not seen or logged by Claude

approvals.text: User request (chat, 2026-10-01): test Transfer completely incl. Confirm Trip -> Inquiry submission -> Inquiry Details, applicable cancellation and payment flows (payment not integrated - record Blocked/Fail). Claude will not enter card/UPI/bank details. New genuine Transfer cases pre-approved for CSV/XLSX.

environmentNotes: Test data created and cleaned up: Transfer inquiries 523 (P2P Majestic->KIA, 2 Oct), 524 (By Hour 4 h, saved as Local), 525 + its outward twin (round trip Majestic<->KIA, 3-4 Oct) - all cancelled (INV-59, INV-60, INV-61). Pay Advance attempted once (gateway error); no payment details entered.

Environment: previous App Live session expired between runs - new session + user re-login (recovery 1). Chrome window kept at ~500-526 px width by the OS/user; device stream fully visible, coordinates recomputed from the viewport probe. App Live Throttle Network (offline) restarts the stream but keeps app state.

cases.actual: Transfer tab shows segment Point To Point (selected) / By Hour; checkboxes 'Point To Point Transfer' (checked) and 'Add Return'; From and To fields with swap icon; Pickup Date & Time; Drop Date & Time (defaults = pickup); Number of Passengers 1; Search Vehicles 'You won't be charged yet!'.

cases.scenario: P2P search with From/To empty and default (past) times
cases.preconditions: Logged in with QA account (credentials in project .env); Home > Transfer > Point To Point untouched
cases.steps: 1. Leave From and To empty 2. Keep default date/time 3. Tap Search Vehicles
cases.expected: Search blocked; field-specific errors under From and To and on past pickup/drop time
cases.actual: Search blocked; 'This field is required' under From and under To; 'Please select a later time.' under Pickup time and Drop time (default time had passed).
cases.notes: Errors use generic wording 'This field is required' instead of field-specific text used on Local/Outstation ('Pickup location is required').

cases.steps: 1. Tap From 2. Read title/subtitle 3. Back 4. Tap To 5. Read title/subtitle
cases.expected: From: 'Enter Pickup Location'; To: 'Enter Drop Location'
cases.actual: From screen: title 'From', subtitle 'Enter Pickup Location'. To screen: title 'To', subtitle 'Enter Drop Location'. Google Places suggestions for 'majestic' and 'kempegowda airport' load correctly.

cases.actual: From Majestic / To Devanahalli (KIA): swap icon interchanges the values (From Devanahalli / To Majestic); tapping again restores the original order.

cases.actual: Drop date stays at 01-10 (before pickup); the only message is 'Please select a later time.' under the drop time; Search blocked. The message does not explain that the drop date is before pickup and drop date is not auto-adjusted.

cases.scenario: Cancellation refund calculation for a Transfer inquiry within 24 hours of pickup
cases.preconditions: Transfer inquiry 523 (Rs 8,000, no advance paid), pickup ~23 h away
cases.steps: 1. Cancel Trip 2. Review Refund Calculation 3. Confirm Cancellation

cases.actual: Trip cost Rs8,000, One day charge Rs0.00, Penalty 20%, 'Add one day charge: Yes' (but charge Rs0), Penalty retained Rs1,600, Refund Rs6,400, Hours before start 23 hours, slab 6 hrs <= T < 24 hrs. P2P inquiry 523 cancelled (INV-59) and By Hour inquiry 524 cancelled (Confirm Cancellation -> 'Booking Cancelled (Inquiry 524)', INV-60: slab 24 hrs <= T < 3 days, penalty 20% + one day charge Rs9,500 = Rs12,800 retained, refund Rs3,700).
